errors.foreign: {path} exists but was not written by this plugin, so it is not overwritten. Pick another target file or move that file away.
errors.invalid: nix-instantiate rejected the generated file, nothing was written: {error}
errors.no_noctalia: The `noctalia` command is not on PATH, so the config cannot be exported.
errors.no_target: No target file is set in the plugin settings.
errors.timeout: {command} did not finish in time, nothing was written. The export is tried again on its own.
errors.unverifiable: {path} exists, but it cannot be checked whether this plugin wrote it ({error}), so it is not replaced.
errors.write: Could not write {path}: {error}. Your user needs write access to the directory.

exclude_paths.description: Dotted paths such as calendar.account or widget.clock.color. * matches one segment, ** any number; \. is a dot in a name. Arrays can only be excluded as a whole.
exclude_paths.label: Manual paths (excluded)

export_mode.description: Which `noctalia config export` mode to mirror: user config only, or the full effective config including built-in defaults.
export_mode.label: Export mode

target_path.description: Path to the generated Nix file. Import it as a settings attribute set in Home Manager.
target_path.label: Target Nix file
